description: This Java class implements the SavingsDropdownReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve various enumeration options related to savings account features such as fees, periods, interest calculation, and posting frequencies.

classes.name: SavingsDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the SavingsDropdownReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve dropdown options for savings account configurations.

methods.name: retrievewithdrawalFeeTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of options for withdrawal fee types, such as flat fee or percentage.

methods.name: retrieveLockinPeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of lock-in period frequency options, e.g., days, weeks, months, years.

methods.name: retrieveCompoundingInterestPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for compounding interest periods, such as daily, monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, annual.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPostingPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for interest posting periods, like daily, monthly, quarterly, biannual, annual.

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns available interest calculation types, such as daily balance or average daily balance.

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for the number of days considered in a year for interest calculation, e.g., 360 or 365 days.
